object: Australian-born British physicist. Nobel Prize 1915 at age 25 — still the youngest Physics laureate. Formulated Bragg's law for X-ray diffraction and founded X-ray crystallography. Later directed the Cavendish Laboratory, overseeing the work that led to the discovery of DNA's structure.
